alternatives: Importing a complete runtime or adopting its local governance was rejected: incompatible scope, licensing and provider assumptions.
Duplicating memory, Scrum coordination or QA agents was rejected; extend existing contracts through explicit dependencies.
Adding all stories to the active sprint or assigning dates without capacity was rejected.
author: codex:engineering
context: Requested on 2026-11-16. Current v4.2 development judgments passed, while story/DoD consolidation and independent qualification remain separate gates. Engineering patterns were assessed statically; no external code, personas, business rules or private assets imported.
decision: Keep original thirty stories intact; add twelve canonical capabilities and a separate non-executable refinement queue. Start with behavior/examples and traceability, then context/CI/readiness, specialization/assets, isolated execution/experience evals and finally optional shadow learning. Existing permission and single-use campaign rules prevail.
